questions.prompt: Which of these are James Bond villains?
questions.fact: Jaws, the giant with steel teeth, changes sides at the end of Moonraker.

questions.prompt: Which of these were invented in ancient China?
questions.fact: China counts four great inventions: paper, printing, gunpowder and the compass.

questions.prompt: How fast does sound travel through air, in metres per second?
questions.fact: About 343 m/s, so count the seconds between lightning and thunder and divide by three to get the distance in kilometres.

questions.prompt: Roughly how many people died when the Titanic sank?
questions.fact: About 1,500 of the roughly 2,200 on board. There were lifeboats for only about half of them.

questions.prompt: Which novel opens with the line "Call me Ishmael"?
questions.hint: It is about a captain hunting a whale.
questions.fact: Herman Melville's Moby-Dick flopped when it came out in 1851 and only became a classic after he died.

questions.prompt: In which sport would you bowl a googly?
questions.hint: It is a ball that spins the opposite way to the one the batter expects.
questions.fact: The googly was invented by an English bowler, Bernard Bosanquet, around 1900.
